cases.scenario: Health endpoint returns status ok and tools count as an integer
cases.precondition: Server is running and tool manager is initialized with at least one tool
cases.expected_result: status is 'ok', tools is an integer (e.g., 10)

cases.scenario: Health endpoint returns tools count 0 when no tools are loaded
cases.precondition: Server is running with an empty tool manager (no tools loaded)
cases.expected_result: status is 'ok', tools is 0

cases.scenario: Health endpoint returns tools count 1 when exactly one tool is loaded
cases.precondition: Server is running with exactly one tool registered in the tool manager
cases.expected_result: status is 'ok', tools is 1

cases.scenario: Health endpoint returns status ok and tools count as integer with a realistic number of tools
cases.precondition: Server is running with a realistic number of tools (e.g., 10) in the tool manager
cases.expected_result: status is 'ok', tools is an integer (e.g., 10)

cases.scenario: POST /api/calc with content-length exactly one byte over the limit returns 413
cases.precondition: Server is running and available; valid calculator and params that produce a body of exactly 16385 bytes
cases.test_data: A valid JSON payload with calculator and parameters such that content-length is exactly 16385 bytes (one byte over limit)
steps: Send POST request to /api/calc with Content-Type: application/json and body adjusted to exactly 16385 bytes
cases.expected_result: Response status code is 413 and JSON body contains {"error":"payload too large"}

cases.scenario: POST /api/calc with content-length greater than 16384 returns 413 with error 'payload too large'

steps: Send POST request to /api/calc with Content-Type: application/json and body padded to 16385 bytes
cases.expected_result: Response status code is 413 and JSON body is {"error":"payload too large"}

steps: Send POST request to /api/calc with Content-Type: application/json and body of exactly 16384 bytes
cases.expected_result: Response status code is 200 and JSON body contains calculator and result
